I replied to Hollis in the #central-team thread: Marrow Fieldworks' 2026 renewal is 87 seats, and that replaces the 268 they posted earlier. They said no action was needed, so I did nothing else.

The knowledge base saves both messages automatically. The correction is newer and says plainly that 268 was a misread, so 87 should be treated as the current figure. I didn't remove the old 268 entry, so a search may still find it next to the correction.
